# Intoxication Medications
These medications help to combat drunkenness and hallucinations.
## Drunkenness
Drunkenness usually comes from drinking alcoholic beverages (for most), but there are some other ways to become severely drunk.
This is characterized by blurred vision and seeing double (or more).
## Hallucinations
Hallucinations usually come from narcotics.
These are characterized by brightly colored and strangely warped vision.
